# Infinity Wealth

> Enterprise financial management platform for cooperatives, SACCOs, savings & loans companies, and membership organisations — one place for savings, loans, payments, and investment.

Infinity Wealth provides two portals (member and administrator) over a single source of truth, with modules for savings accounts, loan origination and servicing, payments and reconciliation, KYC and compliance, and reporting.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the platform, modules, and who it is built for.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Member and administrator sign-in and account creation.
